notes:
1. Section 4 subheading says "Musk says debt access has shut off". Source (CNBC quoting Musk on X): "debt markets have almost entirely shut off access to money for any company that doesn't have substantial revenue independent of AI data centers". Fix: keep "almost entirely" and the condition, e.g. "Musk says debt markets have nearly closed to some AI data center firms" or "Musk warns neoclouds face a debt squeeze".
2. Title "AI's spending is meeting hard questions" and dek "a bank's acquisition ... all surfaced within two days" frame the Itaú section as a hard question about AI spending. That section (Itaú's filing, which describes "significant and transformative results") raises no such question, so title/dek say more than the sections below. Fix: reword the title and dek so Itaú is presented as a bank buying a supplier, e.g. dek "Anthropic's filing, Musk's neocloud warning and an Apollo economist's doubts sit beside a bank buying its own AI supplier."
3. Section 5 says "these four stories describe money for AI that is large, unevenly earned and increasingly scrutinized". "Increasingly scrutinized" and "unevenly earned" are not in any source, and the Itaú story shows neither. Fix: keep section 5 to a plain argument, e.g. "These four stories each concern how AI is paid for or what it returns", and keep the three practical questions.
